title: Partner adoption: explainers used/published; at least 1 documented beneficiary comprehension instance
context: The project is not shipped until real people use the explainers to understand public money. Partner adoption (task 017) secures the partner; this task confirms the closed loop: the partner demonstrably uses or publishes the explainers, and at least one resident, journalist, or official understands a public budget or contracts dataset better as a result — recorded with attestation. This is the project-level Definition of Shipped. Depends on partner-017.
objective: Confirm and document that the secured distribution partner uses or publishes the pilot jurisdiction's explainers, and record at least one documented instance of a resident, journalist, or official understanding the budget or contracts data better as a result — with neutrality independently verified and numeric fidelity upheld throughout.
acceptanceCriteria: The secured partner demonstrably uses or publishes the pilot jurisdiction explainers (confirmed use, not just distribution intent)
At least 1 documented instance of a resident, journalist, or official using an explainer to understand the public budget or contracts better, recorded with attestation
Neutrality independently verified through the full published lifecycle; 'not advice / not an audit' framing intact throughout
Numeric fidelity upheld: all figures reconciled and cited in published versions; no uncited or unreconciled figures in the public artifact
Beneficiary outcome documented (partner/audience use plus comprehension instance) as the project-level Definition of Shipped
output: A handoff and outcome document recording confirmed partner/audience use of the explainers, at least one documented beneficiary comprehension instance with attestation, neutrality verification through the published lifecycle, and numeric fidelity confirmation — the project-level Definition of Shipped.
